name: agent-bom
description: Inventory and audit your AI estate: scan MCP servers, agents and packages for CVEs, supply-chain risk and exposed credentials; audit MCP configs and skills for injection and risky grants; check a server before you add it; plan fixes. Read-only by default and local.

interface.longDescription: Check your AI setup in one step: the MCP servers, agents and packages on this machine, scanned for CVEs, known-exploited and malicious packages, and exposed credentials, with the three fixes that matter most. Ask whether you are affected by a CVE, audit MCP configs and skill files for prompt injection and risky grants, vet a package before you add it, and write an AI-BOM (CycloneDX or SPDX) for this machine, a project, an image or a cloud account. Runs locally from a pinned PyPI release; read-only by default; no account or API key.
defaultPrompt: Check my AI setup: is it safe, and what should I fix first?
Is this package safe to add before I install it?
